tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL OTHER TERMS AND CONDITION AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience in Urban Infrastructure/ Urban Mobility sector Assignments related to Urban infrastructure / city planning / Integrated township development / transport infrastructure / support in investor/developer outreach/ Urban Mobility / Program Management for Infrastructure projects in India-Project fee (excl. taxes) should be greater than Rs 5 Cr. For the longer- term assignments, pro-rated fees for 12 months shall be considered for evaluation purpose. -Projects should have been under implementation/ completed within last 7 years from the date of this RFP -Works related to IT/ audit/ taxation are not eligible At least 3 projects shall be in Infrastructure / Real Estate sector
tenderTechnicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: Experience in Urban Infrastructure / Urban Mobility sector

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience in Public Sector in India Assignments undertaken with central/ state Government departments/ undertakings related to formulating strategy for growth/ turnaround/ transformation/ economic development/ commercialization/ implementation support-Project fee (excl. taxes) should be greater than Rs 5 Cr. For the longer- term assignments, pro-rated fees for 12 months shall be considered for evaluation purpose. -Projects should have been under implementation/ completed within last 7 years from the date of this RfP Works related to IT/ audit/ taxation are not eligible Projects submitted in A1 and A2 shall be considered either in A1 or A2

One detailed case study of an Indian assignment in Urban Infrastructure / mobility focusing on city planning / urban infrastructure / PPP partnerships / mobility planning / integrated township development / transport infrastructure / large project management / commercialization Assignment value INR 5 Crore undertaken by the firm in last 7 years.

One detailed case study on Public Sector experience in Karnataka - Assignments undertaken with State Government departments/ undertakings related to urban infrastructure / formulating strategy for growth/investment attraction/ industrial clusters / commercialization Assignment value equal INR 5 Crore undertaken by the firm in last 7 years.
Quality of approach and methodology a) Demonstrated understanding of the objectives
Quality of approach and methodology b) initial perspectives on key elements of the deliverables
Quality of approach and methodology c) Detailed approach & methodology

Project Team Key Personnel Project Director Urban Development & Regional Planning Expert Economic & Industrial Development Expert Transport & Mobility Expert Infrastructure Finance Expert Key Personnel commitment shall be a mix of on-site / on-line. Key Personnel to be available for relevant key meetings in addition to project director and experts, the consultant shall also deploy a core team of 1 project manager and 2-3 consultants for dedicated support on the project
